name: TinyClaw Proof of Life
description: Phase 5: Verify TinyClaw can make a real tool call via agentic dispatch. The adapter calls the Anthropic Messages API directly with gateway tools, bypassing PicoClaw's text-only dispatch.
process: Call github_fetch to read gateway/main.go from tinyland-inc/remote-juggler
Report the first function definition you find in the file (exported or private), with its line number and whether it's exported
Test error handling by attempting to fetch a non-existent file (gateway/nonexistent.go) and confirm graceful failure
Write a brief __memory__ reflection about this being your first real tool call via agentic dispatch, including how error handling worked

metrics.successCriteria: Agent called github_fetch multiple times (>=2), performed comparative file analysis, calculated efficiency metrics, correctly identified function types, demonstrated error handling, and provided performance benchmarks.
